name: 児童・生徒の自殺等の調査規定を追加
summary: 条例には、重大事態に関する調査の規定があります。改正後は、その規定に当たらない場合でも、学校に在籍する児童・生徒の自殺や、自殺が疑われる死亡が起きたときに、調査組織を設けて事実関係を調べる規定が加わります。
changes: 学校に在籍する児童・生徒の自殺または自殺が疑われる死亡を調査対象に加える
教育委員会または学校に調査組織を設け、速やかに事実関係を調べる
第14条の見出しを「重大事態等」に改め、調査主体の表記を「教育委員会及び」から「教育委員会又は」に改める
専門委員会の名称を「板橋区いじめ問題等専門委員会」に改める
who: 学校に在籍する児童・生徒（幼稚園・保育所を除く）
why: 児童生徒の自殺が起きたときの背景調査の指針の改正を踏まえ、いじめの疑いのない自殺等の事案を調査する規定を加えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds rules for investigating student suicides and suspected suicides
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Itabashi City Ordinance on Basic Principles, Organizations, etc. for Bullying Prevention Measures
en.summary: The ordinance contains provisions for investigating serious incidents. After the amendment, even when a case does not fall under those provisions, if a child or student enrolled at a school dies by suicide or dies in circumstances where suicide is suspected, an investigation body will be set up to investigate the facts.
changes: Adds suicides or deaths suspected to be suicides of children and students enrolled at schools as subjects of investigation
Sets up an investigation body within the Board of Education or the school and promptly investigates the facts
Changes the heading of Article 14 to “Serious Incidents, etc.” and changes the wording identifying the investigating body from “Board of Education and” to “Board of Education or”
Renames the expert committee the “Itabashi City Bullying Issues, etc. Expert Committee”
who: Children and students enrolled at schools (excluding kindergartens and nursery schools)
en.why: The ward says it is adding provisions to investigate cases of suicide, etc. where bullying is not suspected, in light of revisions to the guidelines for investigating the circumstances when children or students die by suicide.
